arxiv-2302-06621.title: Spherical symmetry in the kilonova AT2017gfo/GW170817
arxiv-2302-06621.creator: Albert Sneppen, Darach Watson, Andreas Bauswein, Oliver Just, Rubina Kotak, Ehud Nakar, Dovi Poznanski, Stuart Sim
arxiv-2302-06621.description: Abstract The mergers of neutron stars expel a heavy-element enriched fireball which can be observed as a kilonova Eichler1989 ; Barnes2013 ; Tanvir2013 ; Berger2013 . The kilonova’s geometry is a key diagnostic of the merger and is dictated by the properties of ultra-dense matter and the energetics of the collapse to a black hole.

arxiv-2309-16797.title: Promptbreeder: Self-Referential Self-Improvement via Prompt Evolution
arxiv-2309-16797.creator: Chrisantha Fernando, Dylan Banarse, Henryk Michalewski, Simon Osindero, Tim Rocktäschel Google DeepMind {chrisantha,dylski,henrykm,osindero,rocktaschel}@google.com
arxiv-2309-16797.description: Abstract Popular prompt strategies like Chain-of-Thought Prompting can dramatically improve the reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) in various domains. However, such hand-crafted prompt-strategies are often sub-optimal. In this paper, we present Promptbreeder , a general-purpose self-referential self-improvement mechanism that evolves and adapts prompts for a given domain.

arxiv-2502-19308.title: WOFOSTGym: A Crop Simulator for Learning Annual and Perennial Crop Management Strategies
arxiv-2502-19308.creator: William Solow, Sandhya Saisubramanian, Alan Fern
arxiv-2502-19308.description: Abstract We introduce WOFOSTGym, a novel crop simulation environment designed to train reinforcement learning (RL) agents to optimize agromanagement decisions for annual and perennial crops in single and multi-farm settings. Effective crop management requires optimizing yield and economic returns while minimizing environmental impact, a complex sequential decision-making problem well suited for RL.

pmc-10721280.creator: Elizabeth Hwang-Wong, Gabrielle Amar, Nanditha Das, Xiaoli Zhang, Nina Aaron, Kirsten Gale, Nyanza Rothman, Massimo Fante, Andrew Baik, Ajay Bhargava, Arun Fricker, Michelle McAlister, Jeremy Rabinowitz, John Lees-Shepard, Kalyan Nannuru, Aris N Economides, Katherine D Cygnar
pmc-10721280.description: Mucopolysaccharidosis VI (MPS VI) is a rare lysosomal disease arising from impaired function of the enzyme arylsulfatase B (ARSB). This impairment causes aberrant accumulation of dermatan sulfate, a glycosaminoglycan (GAG) abundant in cartilage. While clinical severity varies along with age at first symptom manifestation, MPS VI usually presents early and strongly affects the skeleton.

pmc-11508992.title: FGFR4 Is Required for Concentric Growth of Cardiac Myocytes during Physiologic Cardiac Hypertrophy
pmc-11508992.creator: Isaac Campos, Beatrice Richter, Sarah Madison Thomas, Brian Czaya, Christopher Yanucil, Dominik Kentrup, Abul Fajol, Qing Li, Stephen M. Secor, Christian Faul
pmc-11508992.description: Fibroblast growth factor (FGF) 23 is a bone-derived hormone that promotes renal phosphate excretion. Serum FGF23 is increased in chronic kidney disease (CKD) and contributes to pathologic cardiac hypertrophy by activating FGF receptor (FGFR) 4 on cardiac myocytes, which might lead to the high cardiovascular mortality in CKD patients.

pmc-12661946.title: Localization of macromolecules in crowded cellular cryo-electron tomograms from extremely sparse labels
pmc-12661946.creator: Mostofa Rafid Uddin, Ajmain Yasar Ahmed, H M Shadman Tabib, Md Toki Tahmid, Md Zarif Ul Alam, Zachary Freyberg, Min Xu
pmc-12661946.description: Localizing macromolecules in crowded cellular cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET) images or tomograms is crucial for determining their in situ structures.
